headline: One follow-up needs doing before the next docs run.
lede: Pass 0’s review found eight small gaps. The session proposes doing one now, four later, and skipping three. Change any call you disagree with.

rows.action: Teach cairn’s docs review page to read the new plan format.
rows.why: Plans now save as YAML; until this lands the review page shows no plan for a new page, and the next docs run depends on it.
rows.detail: From workstation#36: `scripts/docs-review/embed.mjs` `planPathFor` reads only `<slug>.plan.md`, so it can't show a `.plan.yaml`. Your ruling, 2026-10-12: land before the next YAML chain run.

rows.action: Make the plan checker catch a note written after a title or heading.
rows.why: A note there silently cuts the title short, with the page link built from it. Not seen in a real plan yet.
rows.detail: From drafter#1: `title` and `heading` are not prose fields, so `title: X # note` is cut at the comment with no finding.

rows.action: Flag a link that points only at “#”.
rows.why: It passes silently today, and it’s rare.
rows.detail: From drafter#1: a bare `#` link target passes silently.

rows.action: Check that each plan’s page path points inside the repo.
rows.why: A path outside the repo sends the link warnings to the wrong place.
rows.detail: From drafter#1: `page.path` is not validated as repo-relative.

rows.action: Replace a needless pattern match with a plain text search.
rows.why: Tidier code, no change in behavior.
rows.detail: From drafter#1: `bracketRe` is a regexp for a literal `[`.

rows.action: Skip the no-facts warning when a facts list is empty.
rows.why: Harmless as it is; an empty list is rare.
rows.detail: From drafter#1: a `sentence` with `facts: []` still gets the warning.

rows.action: Read the facts folder once per run, not once per plan.
rows.why: Only a speed-up, and runs have few plans.
rows.detail: From drafter#1: `LoadFacts` re-reads the facts directory for each plan.

rows.action: Move the end-to-end test’s program path out of a shared variable.
rows.why: It’s the standard Go test setup; nothing to gain.
rows.detail: From drafter#1: `e2e` keeps the built binary path in a package global.
